subject.title: fix(android): keep composer media with its chat

question: Should Android upgrades adopt the v8 fail-closed migration where legacy outbox rows without a provable agent owner become manual-recovery rows instead of being retried automatically?
rationale: Source inspection can establish that the behavior is internally consistent and safer than replaying against a guessed owner, but only the Android product owner can accept the user-visible upgrade tradeoff and schema-version advance.

options.title: Approve fail-closed migration
options.body: After exact-head release-database upgrade proof, land v8 with ownerless rows visible for manual recovery but never automatically replayed.

options.title: Redesign legacy recovery
options.body: Require a deterministic migration that proves an owner for old rows before retaining automatic retry behavior.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Land only transient composer isolation and defer durable cache and outbox schema ownership to a separately reviewed migration.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed migration
recommendation.body: After exact-head release-database upgrade proof, land v8 with ownerless rows visible for manual recovery but never automatically replayed.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies @obviyus as the Android app owner, and this decision controls Android upgrade and recovery UX.
